verdicts.flaw_description: The particulate figures "cover the scheduled runs that returned a reading", and "a quarter of scheduled runs at each stack returned no reading" - so the 8-14 percent reductions describe only three-quarters of the scheduled firing at every stack, a narrower population than the claim, with no evidence the missing quarter (e.g. analyser dropouts during heavy firing) resembles it.

"Prey abundance on the surrounding farmland doubled from the previous year, and every box stood at the farmland edge, within the birds' foraging range" - a doubled food supply that reaches all four plots is an alternative cause of the 9-16 extra fledglings versus the previous spring, and the report gives no way to separate it from the boxes.

Germination "rates cover the trays that reached the scoring date, and about a fifth of each lot's trays went unscored" - the 6-11 point gains are computed on a surviving 80 percent of trays in every lot, so the reported rates cover a narrower and plausibly better-performing population than the seed lots the claim is about.

"Pass rates cover the students entered for the exam, and about a quarter of each cohort's roll was not entered" - the 4-8 point rises are measured on only the entered three-quarters of each cohort, so entry decisions (e.g. holding weaker students back) could produce the whole gain, and the figure does not describe the cohorts the claim is about.
